text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean absolute error of the median forecast as a percentage of that series' capacity; smaller is better. 292 daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each forecasting up to 14 days ahead. Orange diamond: the best guess (BG2), with its 95% interval from resampling whole months. Green dot: NGED's manual heuristic. Generators are anonymised.'
text.tspan: Mean absolute error of the median forecast as a percentage of that series' capacity; smaller is better. 292

best guess (BG2), with its 95% interval from resampling whole months. Green dot: NGED's manual heuristic.
